sloka: बहुमानात् परिष्वज्य काचिदेनं रुरोद ह ।चरणौ काचिदालिङ्ग्य काचित् कण्ठे ऽवलम्ब्य च ।। ६.११३.८ ।।
transliteration: bahumānāt pariṣvajya kācidenaṁ ruroda ha ।caraṇau kācidāliṅgya kācit kaṇṭhe 'valambya ca ।। 6.113.8 ।।

translations.english: Indeed, out of respect some embraced him and roared aloud, some held his feet and wept, some held his neck and started weeping.
